hello.text: New here? Didn't think so. Fresh boots, clean hands.

outpost.text: The Outpost. We dig, we trade, we keep the lights on. Everything we need comes from below.

first.text: Grab a drill. Grab a weapon. The crates on the pallet by the landing hold kit for newcomers — it's yours. Then take the lift down.

below.text: The Threshold first. Past that... ore, scavengers, and things that dig back. Stay in the light.

line.text: North face gives iron if you're patient. I'm not. The drill is.
Every metre of this wall is somebody's pay. Mostly the Exchange's.
Hear that hum under the hammer? That's not the rock. Don't ask me what it is.
Fresh boots, huh. Lamp on before the Threshold, or you'll come back up in a bag.
